passive_or_low_footprint.description: Opponent hires 0 hands, 0 animals, buys little/no extra land the entire game -- matches the existing 'conservative'/'passive' archetypes reasonably well.

sustained_multi_resource_scaler.description: NEW/UNREPRESENTED regime before this phase -- opponent commits to sustained high hands (6-12) AND/OR high animal count (up to 19), sometimes with additional land, maintained for most of the season. None of the 7 existing archetypes combine sustained high labor AND high animals this way.

high_labor_low_conversion.description: Opponent sustains high hands (7-8) but ends with low final money (<$10k) -- labor committed but apparently not converted into revenue effectively. Distinct from the scaler category above (same INPUT commitment, very different OUTPUT) -- a possible execution-quality axis independent of resource commitment.
high_labor_low_conversion.new_archetype_added: NONE -- flagged as NEW/UNREPRESENTED REGIME, not yet reconstructed

modest_crop_choice_advantage.description: Opponent stays at a resource level comparable to ours but chooses a crop (STRAWBERRY, in 2 of 4 cases) whose price held up better than our MELON-solo default.

note: Every categorization here used the FULL daily trajectory (results/phase3_5/trajectories/), not a single final-state screenshot, per the brief's explicit instruction.
confidence_label: SUPPORTED (direct measurement); category boundaries are informal groupings for discussion, not a fitted/validated classifier
